OrganizationUserUpdateSchema.title: OrganizationUserUpdateSchema

SessionSchema.title: SessionSchema

cookieAuth.name: access_token
cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly session cookie set by `POST /api/v1/auth/login`. Unsafe methods also need a trusted `Origin` (or `Referer`).

bearerAuth.description: Access JWT minted server-side (tests, scripts). Browsers use the cookie.
